groove.title: BOLLO — five-second coin percussion instrument proof
groove.timing: actual normalized note onsets; nearest absolute frame, no second PPQ quantization; noteEndFrame is nominal gate release onset, not rack acoustic end
groove.stemConvention: all stems include master gain; sum all parts and room to reconstruct master before quantization
groove.provenance: Every WAV is computed by scripts/generate-v12-signature.ts from numeric parameters and seeded xorshift32 noise. No recordings, downloaded samples, SoundFonts, impulse responses, loops or third-party audio are read or embedded.

interpolation.scope: one render; source PCM identity, playback rate/glide/offset, explicit endpoint and rendered frame count; velocity/envelope per onset; full continuous track/master processing

groove.coinTiming: same absolute frames as original bridge; pitch ignored; note velocity scales incoming speed; natural physical release, nominal gate ignored; coin room send unsupported
